exclusions: API keys, .env, service configs, auth tokens
full original 3081-document corpus and indexed raw chunks
runtime configs with embedded raw corpus and privacy mapping
raw provider request/response traces, events, records, all_answers, logs
unrelated upstream frontend, binaries, dependencies and caches
Historical source snapshots, internal planning and personal job-preparation material
Personal local paths, author contact information and original operational deployment identifiers
note: Source hashes identify original local artifacts where available; export hashes identify the current public files. Historical records describe their original experiment/export, not new efficacy or live deployment validation. The manifest omits its own hash.
manifest_self_hash: Not included; Git commit authenticates the manifest together with all tracked files.

incremental_update.scope: Current agent, Shanghai integration owning sources, medical assistant API and frontend overlay, offline tests; not a complete RAGFlow checkout.

publication_cleanup.scope: Current source overlay and selected public-source benchmark/evaluation records
publication_cleanup.credential_review: Gitleaks 8.30.1 and manual review found no authentic credentials; hash/fixture false positives were individually reviewed. Reachable history is rechecked before publication.
publication_cleanup.deployment_binding: Required independently configured POLICY_APPROVED_TENANT_ID, POLICY_APPROVED_KB_ID, POLICY_APPROVED_CHAT_ID and POLICY_APPROVED_RERANK_MODEL_ID; no private built-in identifiers. Ownership and budget guards retained.
publication_cleanup.retained_corpus_linkage: Public-source benchmark document, dataset and chunk identifiers retained consistently; they are not credentials.
publication_cleanup.historical_reproducibility_limit: Historical source snapshots are excluded; selected reports, source references, split evidence and negative results are retained. Full historical runs require original local inputs.

validation.independent_review: No actionable findings after full source/documentation/history-filter review
